mentions.name: Survive 10 Waves
mentions.description: A browser game built from scratch with no prior game development experience, created using AI as part of an experiment, with the game currently being prepared for publication on Steam.
mentions.source_excerpt: I was curious about what it would take to build a browser game from scratch with zero game dev experience using AI and created https://survive10waves.com :) Currently trying to publish the game on Steam!
mentions.author: trungdq88
